unnamed.name: Nobody named yet
unnamed.says: A booking starts with nobody named, a party of one, and no seat or wish.

named.name: Named
named.says: Once there is a name, the seat, the party and a wish can be chosen, in any order.

booked.name: Booked
booked.says: Booking is the end of it: after that nothing can be changed.

name-first.name: Give a name
name-first.says: The person booking gives a name before anything else can be chosen.

rename.name: Change the name
rename.says: The name can be changed again, up to the moment the table is booked.

seat.name: Choose a seat
seat.says: The person chooses a seat: by the window or on the aisle, offered as "window" and "aisle".

party-size.name: Set the party
party-size.says: A party is one to six people, and one to start with.

wish.name: Say a wish
wish.says: The person may say once what they would like: a quiet table, or one near the door, offered as "quiet" and "near the door".

ready.name: Book
ready.says: The table can be booked once there is a name and a seat.

name-length.says: A name is at most twelve characters, and nothing else is asked of it: even an empty one is taken.

name-reserved.says: "admin" is never a name somebody books under.

name-unchanged.says: Giving the name it already has is refused, since nothing would change.

party-unchanged.says: Setting the party to the size it already is is refused.

quiet-is-small.says: A quiet table can only be asked for by a party of two or fewer. The party is not held to it afterwards, and may still grow.

summary.says: The screen shows who is booking, the seat, the party and what they would like, and whether the table can be booked yet.
